acip: LAS KYI SGRIB PA RNAM PAR DAG PA'I MDO LAS TSOGS DANG DUS NI RNYED GYUR NAS, ZHES BYA BA NI JI LTAR SA BON MTHU MA NYAMS PA DANG LDAN PA LA SA DANG CHU DANG ME, DANG RLUNG DANG NAM MKHA'I RKYEN RNAMS TSOGS NA DUS JI LTA BA BZHIN DU MYU GU, MNGON PAR SGRUB PAR BYED DO
wylie: las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa'i mdo las tshogs dang dus ni rnyed gyur nas, zhes bya ba ni ji ltar sa bon mthu ma nyams pa dang ldan pa la sa dang chu dang me, dang rlung dang nam mkha'i rkyen rnams tshogs na dus ji lta ba bzhin du myu gu, mngon par sgrub par byed do
english: The Sutra on the Complete Purification of Every Karmic Obstacle includes that line about "If there comes a situation where they all assemble, and the the time is ripe..." The point here is that a sprout will be produced at such time as the following are complete: a seed whose power has not been ruined, and the contributing factors of earth, water, heat, air, and space.
